notes: Flood polygons approximate the zones inondables along the Riviere des Prairies (north shore of the island) — the areas hit by the 2017 and 2019 spring floods (Pierrefonds-Roxboro, Ahuntsic-Cartierville, Riviere-des-Prairies/Pointe-aux-Trembles). Wildfire is not relevant to Montreal. Refine against the CMM / Ville de Montreal zones inondables (0-20 an and 20-100 an) geospatial layers when curating.
